t: The AI-First Web: Unmasking the Invisible FUBAR with Pipulate
s: The article argues that the web is shifting to an 'AI-first' paradigm, exposing fundamental architectural flaws ('FUBAR') invisible to humans but critical for AI. Pipulate is presented as a tool to provide AI with the same layered perspective humans use to inspect web content, enabling better understanding and interaction.
sub: The 'AI Optimization' (AIO) hubris vs. AI's superior pattern matching capabilities.
Google's ad revenue driven 'Nash equilibrium' delaying the AI-driven cleanup of spam.
Historical parallels between the 'mobile-first' transition (AMP) and the current AI-first shift.
Pipulate as a tool providing AI with access to the rendered DOM, accessibility tree, and other crucial page interpretations.
The breakdown of the semantic web by modern frameworks (React, Angular) creating an 'AI-proof vault'.
